programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Ron Carter
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Maynard Ferguson
programme.sub-title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report's “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.desc: Young Mary follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest and discovers an old broomstick and the strange Fly-by-Night flower, a rare plant that blossoms once every seven years. Together, the flower and the broomstick whisk Mary above the clouds, and far away to Endor College, a school of magic...

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: It's a race for survival in the criminal underworld of New York in the action-packed thriller TRACERS.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

programme.title: A Handful of Dust
programme.desc: The wife's affair and a death in the family hasten the demise of an upper-class English marriage.

programme.title: Blackbeard Part One
programme.desc: In 1717, Royal Navy Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent to the West Indies on a secret mission to destroy notorious pirate ship The Queen Anne's Revenge and its crew.

programme.title: Blackbeard Part Two
programme.desc: In 1717, Royal Navy Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent to the West Indies on a secret mission to destroy notorious pirate ship The Queen Anne's Revenge and its crew.

programme.title: Bonds will be Broken
programme.desc: When her sister Nina is seduced by a mysterious self-improvement cult, Anna decides to go undercover at the cult's annual retreat to save her sister from the sinister cult leader.

programme.title: A Hologram For The King
programme.desc: Set during the recession and following a desperate businessman (Tom Hanks) in Saudi Arabia who attempts to leave his mark on the world while fighting foreclosure and paying his daughter's tuition.

programme.title: Hoosiers
programme.desc: A man gets a last-chance job coaching a small-town Indiana high-school basketball team and faces the dual challenge of bringing this underdog team to the 1951 state championship and redeeming himself from a mysterious past.

programme.title: Dreamin Wild
programme.desc: What if a childhood dream suddenly came true - but thirty years later? That's what happened to singer/songwriter Donnie Emerson. His dream of success suddenly – and unexpectedly – came true but only as he approached 50 years old.

programme.title: Barbershop
programme.desc: Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: The rookie cops duke it out for a cause at “Fite Nite.”

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy trades in her uniform for something more risqué when she goes undercover as a prostitute.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: During a home invasion, Andy is left alone and confronted with a hiding thief who is armed and very volatile.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: A fatal traffic collision reveals a shocking truth, and Andy's romance with Det. Callaghan gets complicated.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Siberian gulag escapees travel four thousand miles by foot to freedom in India.

programme.title: Wolfhound
programme.desc: A skilled warrior, Volkodav, sets out on a mission to avenge the slaughter of his family and tribe.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: For the Love of Benji
programme.desc: Benji is on holiday with his family in Greece, but after getting separated at the airport, he finds himself on another exciting adventure, now on the run from international spies!

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

programme.title: Lez Bomb
programme.desc: Lez Bomb is a hilarious and sweet “coming out” comedy in the vein of Meet the Parents from Bobby Farrelly, producer of There's Something about Mary. Lauren, (Writer-Director Jenna Laurenzo) comes home with life changing news. As it turns out, there is no good time to drop the Lez Bomb.

programme.title: A Random Encounter
programme.desc: Starring the charming Meghan Markle (Suits), this whirlwind rom-com proves that finding Prince Charming can be a right royal pain. Sassy Mindy is well and truly immersed in the superficial dating scene, while her best friend Laura is a hopeless romantic. So when she has a chance moment with a stranger in a coffee shop, she is left wondering whether this could blossom into a lifelong romance?

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: A brilliantly hilarious "in tents" comedy drama, starring David Arquette, Amy Acker and Academy Award nominee June Squibb. With their marriage on the rocks, Jack and Amanda head off on a glamping trip to "reignite their spark". But when their blissful romantic getaway is hijacked by a pair of hipster honeymooners and a hunky land-owner, they are left in more trouble than before!

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: A highly-compelling political thriller from award-winning director Agniezka Holland. Welsh journalist Gareth Jones (James Norton: Little Women) risks his life to expose the truth about the devastating famine in the Soviet Union in the early 1930s. Also starring Vanessa Kirby (The Crown) and Golden Globe Nominee Peter Sarsgaard (The Batman). This is the most important true story you will ever see.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: Céline
programme.desc: Céline tells the unforgettable love story of one of the most compelling celebrity couples of all time and chronicles the rise to fame of the world's greatest pop superstar.

programme.title: The Man in the Hat
programme.desc: The Man in the Hat (Ciarán Hinds) journeys through France in a Fiat 500 accompanied by a framed photograph of an unknown woman. He is pursued by five angry men in a Citroën Dyane.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: The Christmas Chalet
programme.desc: (2019) Festive rom-com starring Erica Durance. Sparks fly when a Christmas loving woman and a man who hates it double-book a chalet. But can the magic of Christmas thaw even the frostiest of hearts?

programme.title: The Perfect Christmas Village
programme.desc: (2018) Festive fantasy with Caitlin Thompson. Christmas control freak Darcy is magically transported to her perfect festive village giving her a chance to rediscover the true meaning of the holidays.

programme.title: The Christmas Setup
programme.desc: (2020) Festive rom com with Hugo Spencer and Blake Lee. Back home for Christmas, big city lawyer Hugo is set up by his matchmaker mum with his high school crush Patrick. Is the magic still there?

programme.title: Christmas In My Heart
programme.desc: (2021) Festive romance with Heather Hemmens. Back home for Christmas, violinist Beth starts tutoring the daughter of a reclusive country music star. Will they end up making sweet music together?

programme.title: Christmas Truce
programme.desc: (2015) Romantic war drama with Craig Olejnik and Ali Liebert. After falling in love amid the Battle of the Bulge, a US soldier and a Belgian woman vow to reunite at war's end - if they survive...

programme.title: Vita & Virginia
programme.desc: It's the fascinating true story about the love affair between socialite and popular author Vita Sackville-West and literary icon Virginia Woolf, and the love story that inspired Virginia Woolf's Orlando. Starring Gemma Arterton, Elizabeth Debicki and Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Two strangers who drunkenly got married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot after having their annulment denied by a judge.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

programme.title: A Kind of Magic
programme.desc: Meeting at a Halloween party, Matt and Sara have an instant connection, but they agree to not exchange numbers. What they don't realize is that by meeting, they've set in motion events that will change both their lives in magical ways.

programme.title: Return To Me
programme.desc: A man who falls in love with the woman who received his wife's heart must decide which woman it is who holds his heart.

programme.title: Christmas in Mississippi
programme.desc: Photographer Holly returns to Gulfport, Mississippi for Christmas. Their traditional holiday light show has been revived again since a hurricane struck five years earlier. She is shocked to learn the festival is run by her high school sweetheart, Mike.

programme.title: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Starring Mayim Bialik and Ryan McPartlin. Two strangers offer to share the last remaining room at a bed-and-breakfast when a snowstorm strands their flight in Montana on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Finding Love In Sisters
programme.desc: When her mother dies, Esperanza returns to Sisters, Oregon and reunites with her sisters.

programme.title: Hope's Legacy
programme.desc: When her grandmother leaves her the family ranch, a young woman is inspired to enter the world of competitive horse riding. Old flames, self-doubt, and other obstacles stand in her way of success but with the support of her fianceé, family, and neighbors, she learns to grab life by the reins to make her dreams come true.

programme.title: Scents and Sensibility
programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen's Sense and Sensibility, Elinor and Marianne find themselves penniless after their father's fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

programme.title: A Teacher's Crime
programme.desc: Attractive teacher Carrie befriends blackmailed student Jeremy, uncle Bill.

programme.title: Dark Influences
programme.desc: First-hand accounts of people who were manipulated, abused and finally broke free.

programme.title: The Rival
programme.desc: Alice loses baby in robbery marries George Miller. Stars Tracy Nelson.

programme.title: Abducted on Prom Night
programme.desc: Divorced mom lets troubled daughter attend prom night turns into hostage crisis.

programme.title: Dating Hell
programme.desc: Divorced mom Hannah uses a popular dating app to find the wonderful Daniel.

programme.title: Michelle/Troy and Josh
programme.desc: Three masked gunmen burst into Michelle's home.

programme.title: The Love Club: Sydney
programme.desc: When Sydney reconnects with her ex and joins a Half Marathon he is running, she asks the Love Club to help.

programme.title: The wrong Nanny
programme.desc: When Blake finds her birth mother and her now-perfect family, Blake will do anything it takes to destroy it.

programme.title: A Friend's Obsession
programme.desc: After Megan's fiancé is killed, Lloyd follows her to win her love, but her new boyfriend stands in the way.

programme.title: A Lethal Lesson
programme.desc: High school teacher Lauren is accused of an affair by a student, putting her job and life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Eve of Abduction
programme.desc: When a single mother gets engaged, she receives a threat—break off the engagement or her daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: Did You Hear About The Morgans?
programme.desc: The comedy Did You Hear About the Morgans? follows a highly successful Manhattan couple, Meryl and Paul Morgan (Sarah Jessica Parker and Hugh Grant), whose almost-perfect lives have only one notable failure: their dissolving marriage. But the turmoil of their romantic lives is nothing compared to what they are about to experience: they witness a murder and become targets of a contract killer.

programme.title: Friends With Money
programme.desc: Three well-heeled married women and their single, financially challenged friend negotiate the waters of friendship, relationships, careers and money.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding (1997)
programme.desc: Two friends (Julia Roberts and Dermot Mulroney) go from an impossible possibility to an unimaginable reality in this romantic comedy.

programme.title: Did You Hear About The Morgans?
programme.desc: The comedy Did You Hear About the Morgans? follows a highly successful Manhattan couple, Meryl and Paul Morgan (Sarah Jessica Parker and Hugh Grant), whose almost-perfect lives have only one notable failure: their dissolving marriage. But the turmoil of their romantic lives is nothing compared to what they are about to experience: they witness a murder and become targets of a contract killer.

programme.title: She's The Man
programme.desc: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

programme.title: Gloves Off
programme.desc: Doug was an amazing fighter, but a less than amazing businessman. Saddled with a gym in debt he is struggling to keep his business afloat. Now he will have to try and save his beloved gym from being turned into a modern chain-gym by training a gentle giant for a bare-knuckle figh.

programme.title: The Grand Seduction
programme.desc: Brendan Gleeson is Murray, a once proud fisherman who now, along with his former colleagues in the harbour of Tickle Head are out of work and forced to live off welfare.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: When Arthur and Martha find that their pension pot is virtually worthless they decide to take drastic action by robbing a bank! After their first robbery is successful they start to like the criminal lifestyle, but as the robberies get riskier will they be able to outwit the police as they close in?

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: As tensions rise between settlers and the Assiniboins, Winnetou works to preserve peace. A corrupt oilman, Bud Forrester, stages attacks to spark a war and seize oil-rich Native land. Joined by Old Shatterhand and Lord Castlepool, Winnetou must expose the conspiracy before violence becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The Hired Hand
programme.desc: Harry returns home to his wife and farm after drifting with his friend Arch and has to make a difficult decision regarding his loyalties.

programme.title: Running Target
programme.desc: In the Colorado Rockies, Sheriff Scott, heads a posse that is after four escaped convicts, and thought it is his sworn duty to return the men dead or alive, he is, as always, reluctant to kill his fellow man.

programme.title: Django Meets Sartana
programme.desc: The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer.

programme.title: Band Waggon
programme.desc: After eviction from Broadcasting House, Arthur and Stinker stage a TV show in a castle used by German agents.

programme.title: A Cottage to Let
programme.desc: A military inventor is unaware he is under the watchful gaze of spies during World War II.

programme.title: Find the Lady
programme.desc: A model investigates the disappearance of her grandmother and is drawn into a web of kidnapping and murder.

programme.title: Clockwise
programme.desc: One little slip destroys Brian's schedule turning one of the most important days of his life into a disaster.

programme.title: Happiest Days of Your Life
programme.desc: Confusion at The Ministry results in a girls school being joined with a boys school.

programme.title: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: The Executioners Mask
programme.desc: When a model's face is disfigured after she puts on the mask of a French executioner, Sydney and Nigel will try and find the tomb to reverse the curse.

programme.title: The Royal Ring
programme.desc: When the British Museum gets Sidney and Nigel to help search at Tudor sites for a ring of King Henry VIII, Nigel is confronted with his self-confident pestering elder brother Preston Bailey.

programme.title: Set in Stone
programme.desc: In a monastery, Knight Gabriel impales a demon, which then turns to stone. In 2001, Nigel and Sydney arrive bearing a letter from a monk, but the abbot claims it is a forgery and shuts them out.

programme.title: Deadline

programme.title: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney runs into her ex Gray and goes on a holiday with him to Bali, but when Derek Lloyd shows up to enlist her to find Parvati's Bowl, she can't resist.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
programme.desc: Clary Fray thinks she is just an ordinary teenager living in Brooklyn, but everything changes one night when in a downtown club she encounters the mysterious and charismatic Jace , and witnesses a shocking murder.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former protégé to flush out the real culprit.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon finally tracks down her missing sister Raven, she's elated to be back together – until she begins to suspect that Raven isn't her sister at all, but rather an opportunistic imposter.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: At 500 MPH disaster is inevitable. When an experiment goes disastrously wrong, a rash of massive hurricanes rips across North America. A scientist must get his family to safety before the hurricanes merge, creating a "hypercane" with the power to wipe America off the map.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate the murder of a rap group while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only profession where a guy can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Deeply ensconced in a top-secret military program, three pilots struggle to bring an artificial intelligence program under control ... before it initiates the next world war.

programme.desc: After capturing crooked cops killing drug dealers on her body cam, a female rookie must evade the narcotics officers who are after the incriminating evidence.

programme.title: Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a "Solo Piano Summit," audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson. Besides solo performances the all-stars used the occasion for spontaneous interplay, improvisation and a fantastic finale - in short for the pleasure of virtuoso jazz piano playing.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Ron Carter
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Maynard Ferguson
programme.sub-title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report's “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Good morning, Babilonia
programme.desc: Entrada la segunda década del siglo XX, y tras la quiebra de la cantera familiar, los hermanos Nicola y Andrea emigran de Italia a América en busca de fortuna. Ambos acaban trabajando en Hollywood construyendo decorados para el famoso cineasta D.W. Griffith. Pero la tragedia llega a sus vidas con el estallido de la Primera Guerra Mundial, en la que Nicola y Andrea luchan en bandos opuestos.

programme.title: El valle oscuro
programme.desc: Un jinete solitario llega a un remoto y aislado pueblo de los Alpes austríacos, donde, a pesar de no ser bienvenido, se le permite quedarse antes del duro invierno. Se presenta como un fotógrafo de Estados Unidos, pero nadie sospecha que el misterioso extranjero ha llegado al valle para cumplir una venganza. La violencia flota en el aire en este pueblo de leñadores, dominado por un viejo clan familiar que impone sus leyes, aterrorizando a sus habitantes.

programme.title: El regreso de la cosa del pantano
programme.desc: La cosa del pantano es en realidad Alec Holland, un científico brillante transformado en mitad hombre, mitad planta. Avergonzado de su apariencia, vive solo en el pantano hasta que se cruza con la bella Abigail, hijastra del malvado Dr. Arcane.

programme.title: El extranjero
programme.desc: Argelia 1935. Mersault, un modesto empleado que vive y trabaja en Argel, recibe la noticia de la muerte de su madre. Después del funeral, encuentra a Marie, una mecanógrafa amiga suya, y comienza una relación con ella.

programme.title: Diarios de Motocicleta
programme.desc: En 1952, dos jóvenes argentinos, Ernesto Guevara y Alberto Granado, emprenden un viaje por carretera para descubrir la verdadera América Latina. Los dos amigos dejan Buenos Aires en una desvencijada motocicleta Norton de 500cc del año 1939, llevados por un romántico espíritu aventurero. Sus experiencias harán despertar en ellos a los hombres en que se convertirán en el futuro y que definirán sus vidas.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión.

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: Siempre Alice
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Julianne Moore), 2014. La doctora Alice Howland es una profesora casada y madre de 3 hijos, no da importancia a los pequeños lapsus hasta que debe comenzar a luchar para seguir siendo Alice.

programme.title: Pride

programme.title: Presa

programme.title: La Bahía Del Silencio
programme.desc: La repentina desaparición de su esposa e hijos lleva a Will a una búsqueda frenética por Europa.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un conserje queda atrapado en un parque maldito y lucha por sobrevivir a sus letales personajes.

programme.title: La Directora de orquesta
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales. Cuenta la historia de Antonia Brico, una joven que sueña en convertirse en directora de orquesta, pero nadie la toma en serio por ser una mujer.

programme.title: Mi querido dictador
programme.desc: Tatiana Mills una estudiante estadounidense de 16 años escribe, como trabajo de clase, una carta a Anton Vincent, un notorio dictador de una nación isleña del Caribe. Tras siglos de opresión los habitantes de la isla se rebelan finalmente contra la dictadura y Anton es derrocado por su propio pueblo

programme.title: Frances Ha
programme.desc: Frances vive en Nueva York, aunque no tiene un apartamento. Es aprendiz en una compañía de danza, aunque no es realmente bailarina. Tiene una mejor amiga llamada Sophie, pero ahora mismo no se hablan. Frances quiere mucho más de lo que tiene, pero disfruta de la vida con alegría y despreocupación.

programme.title: Deseando amar
programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: En el nombre del rey
programme.desc: Película basada en el popular videojuego Dungeon Siege. Historia de corte medieval en la que un granjero de origen humilde consigue convertirse en un heroico y valeroso príncipe que tendrá que salvar su reino de un oscuro y tenebroso final.

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: Drama judicial basado en el libro 'History On Trial'. La película cuenta el juicio entre la autora del libro, Deborah E. Lipstadt, y David Irving, famoso periodista admirador de Hitler al que ella había acusado de negar el holocausto, motivo por el que él se querelló contra ella por difamaciones.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: Katie Lapp ha anhelado las cosas prohibidas, pero ¿sus sueños llegarán a un precio demasiado caro para pagar? ¿Por qué la madre de Katie, una simple mujer amish, escondería un hermoso vestido de bebé en el ático?

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Una fatídica noche, en un pequeño teatro regional inglés durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de actores en gira representan la obra "El rey Lear" de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Irrational Man
programme.desc: El profesor de filosofía Abe Lucas ha tocado fondo a nivel emocional y se ve incapaz de encontrarle ningún sentido ni alegría a su vida. Abe tiene la sensación de no haber marcado la más mínima diferencia con nada de lo que ha emprendido en su vida, desde el activismo político a la enseñanza.

programme.title: Libertad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real. Dos hombres separados por 100 años están unidos en su búsqueda hacia la libertad. En 1856, un esclavo, Samuel Woodward y su familia, escapan de la plantación Monroe cerca de Virginia.

programme.title: Una casa de locos
programme.desc: Un parisino de 27 años decide ir a Barcelona a estudiar el último año de la carrera de economía.

programme.title: Tres
programme.desc: Una diseñadora de sonido pasa horas trabajando. ¿Pero su cerebro está empezando a perder sincronización?

programme.title: Juegos de la Vida
programme.desc: Una pareja humilde en La Habana decide regalarse algo especial por su aniversario.

programme.title: Todo es relativo
programme.desc: Harry ama a Grace, pero un secreto familiar convierte su historia de amor en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea, una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses.

programme.title: De vuelta a casa
programme.desc: Alice (Reese Witherspoon) es una mujer recién separada que decide enfrentarse a nuevos retos y vuelve a Los Ángeles para construirse una nueva vida. Un nuevo trabajo que no es exactamente lo que ella esperaba, un colegio nuevo para sus hijos y facturas que pagar.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez interpreta a una chica normal cuyo viaje de verano a París resulta ser la fantasía de su vida cuando se convierte en princesa accidentalmente al asumir la identidad de otra persona.

programme.title: Chungking Express
programme.desc: Dos historias de amor en un popular barrio turístico de Hong Kong. La primera describe el encuentro entre un joven policía y una misteriosa mujer fatal traficante de drogas. La segunda entre un solitario agente de policía y la joven camarera del bar donde aquél suele comer.

programme.title: Date el piro, vampiro
programme.desc: Matt descubre que su hermano Deco es un vampiro. ¿Debe un ingenuo adolescente ayudar a su familiar marginado a seguir cazando o hundirle una estaca para proteger al mundo?

programme.title: El cocinero de los últimos deseos
programme.desc: Mitsuru Sasaki es un cocinero que puede hacer maravillosas comidas sin siquiera pensarlo. Pero es tan perfeccionista que pierde su reputado restaurante y se ve obligado a cocinar por encargo. Un día, recibe una solicitud especial para cocinar un mítico banquete espectacular del siglo pasado. El problema es que necesita descubrir la receta del famoso chef Yamagata, que estuvo en la Manchuria ocupada por China en la década de 1930.

programme.title: El hombre perfecto
programme.desc: Mathieu, de 25 años, siempre ha aspirado a convertirse en un autor reconocido. Un sueño que parece inalcanzable para él, porque…

programme.title: Especiales
programme.desc: La historia de Bruno y Malik, dos amigos que durante veinte años han vivido en un mundo diferente: el de los niños y adolescentes autistas. A cargo de dos organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro, forman a jóvenes para que sean cuidadores de casos extremos. De esta forma crean una asociación excepcional, fuera de los entornos tradicionales, para unas personas extraordinarias.

programme.title: Buster el robo del siglo
programme.desc: Basada en la vida de Buster Edwards, un encantador padre de familia que atracó un tren correo de Glasgow.

programme.title: Pixie
programme.desc: Joven planea robo y enfrenta criminales.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: El Partido Repartido
programme.desc: Bryan, un ambicioso joven político, conoce a Serena, una poderosa mujer dentro del partido político.

programme.title: Charada
programme.desc: Tras unos días de esquí, Regina vuelve a Parías con la idea de pedir el divorcio. Cuando llega su casa está desvalijada y su esposo asesinado. A ella la acosarán los asesinos que quieren saber dónde escondió su marido una importante fortuna.

programme.title: Tiene que ser amor
programme.desc: La acción de la película se desarrolla durante la mágica época entre Navidad y Año Nuevo. La agitación amorosa lleva a las tres hermanas a la romántica Sopot, donde, como parte de las deliberaciones familiares, deben decidir qué hacer con sus vidas románticas.

programme.title: In the Loop
programme.desc: El Presidente de EE.UU. y el Primer Ministro británico deciden iniciar una guerra y prometen ser rápidos. El Secretario de Estado británico para el desarrollo internacional, respalda accidentalmente la acción militar en horario de máxima audiencia en televisión, ganando muchos amigos en Washington.

programme.title: El hombre que no sabía nada
programme.desc: Pensando que está participando en una actuación de teatro callejero, el empleado estadounidense de una tienda de videos es confundido con un espía internacional y se abre paso a través de una red de espionaje, superando inadvertidamente a los principales asesinos de Europa.

programme.title: Pesadillas
programme.desc: Zach Cooper descubre el lado positivo de mudarse a un pueblo pequeño cuando conoce a su vecina Hannah, la hija de R. L. Stine, el célebre escritor de la serie Pesadillas. Stine es un hombre misterioso que vive prisionero de su propia imaginación, ya que los monstruos que sus libros hicieron famosos resultan ser reales y debe mantenerlos encerrados en sus manuscritos para proteger a sus lectores. Cuando los monstruos se liberan accidentalmente y comienzan a sembrar el terror en el pueblo, dependerá de Stine, Zach y Hannah hacer que regresen a los libros a los que pertenecen.

programme.title: Ejecutivo Agresivo
programme.desc: El empresario Dave Buznik es normalmente afable y nada polémico. Pero tras un altercado a bordo de un avión, es condenado a participar en un programa de gestión de la ira. Allí descubre que su propio instructor, el Dr. Buddy Rydell, tiene un grave problema de ira, un problema que solo se revelará del todo después de que el doctor se traslade a casa de Dave para darle lecciones prácticas sobre "comportamiento calmado".

programme.title: Exceso De Equipaje
programme.desc: Alicia Silverstone es una chica rica, pero está tan harta de que su padre no se nocupe ella en absoluto que decide fingir su propio secuestro para llamar así su atención. Todo sale según sus planes hasta que un ladrón (Benicio del Toro) roba el coche en cuyo maletero está escondida.

programme.title: Dick y Jane Ladrones de Risa
programme.desc: Nada más ascender, el ambicioso Dick se ve obligado a comparecer ante las cámaras de televisión para explicar por qué el presidente de su empresa Globodyne se ha desecho repentinamente de sus acciones. Dick se ve envuelto en una especie de escándalo corporativo: en un instante pierde todo lo que pensaba que tenía.

programme.title: De hombre a hombre
programme.desc: Un joven pistolero planea localizar y eliminar a los bandidos que mataron a su familia, y forma una tenue alianza con un anciano ex forajido, hasta el sorprendente final.

programme.title: La diligencia
programme.desc: Un grupo, que se encuentra con una posta, se une a la lucha contra Geronimo y se aleja de ella.

programme.title: ¡Ay, Jalisco no te rajes!
programme.desc: Western clásico de vaqueros hecho en México.

programme.title: La pradera sangrienta
programme.desc: Cuando el despiadado Ben Thompson mata al alguacil, Clay Hardin deja todo para cazarlo. En su persecución, se une a un cazarrecompensas y a una mestiza, adentrándose en tierras apaches. Pero la misión se complica cuando descubren un peligroso tráfico de armas. Entre la venganza y la justicia, Clay enfrenta una batalla donde la ley y la moral se ponen a prueba.

programme.title: Soy Judio
programme.desc: Una historia apasionante donde la fe y el amor se ponen a prueba. "Soy Judío" es un proyecto cinematográfico de Andariego Films y Parabollum que explora emociones profundas y desafíos personales.

programme.title: El pirata
programme.desc: El pirata griego reconvertido en hombre de negocios Ioannis Varvakis hizo fortuna vendiendo caviar en Rusia y en todo el mundo. Varvakis lucha toda su vida por la libertad para sí mismo y luego para su país.

programme.title: Muerto por Carol
programme.desc: Carol se muda con su padre y abuelo al tranquilo pueblo de Zapote, donde experimenta la intensidad del primer amor junto a Rito. Entre descubrimientos, emociones y el despertar de nuevos sentimientos, su vida cambia para siempre en esta historia íntima y entrañable.

programme.title: Barrancas
programme.desc: Una película llena de suspenso, emoción y giros inesperados.

programme.title: Punto de Control
programme.desc: Port City Carolina del Norte: Durante una acampada rutinaria, un vagabundo local, ex marine descubre planes para una invasión en América.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Martin es un ex parisino que ha regresado a su pueblo natal en Normandía para hacerse cargo de la panadería de su padre. De su juventud le queda una gran imaginación y su pasión por la literatura, con un profundo aprecio por Gustave Flaubert. La emoción le invade cuando un matrimonio inglés se instala en la casa vecina, no sólo porque sus nombres son Gemma y Charles Bovery, sino porque sus comportamientos parecen replicar los de los personajes de la obra Madame Bovary, que incluye una serie de relaciones románticas y sexuales que se encaminan hacia un final incierto. Pero la hermosa Gemma no ha leído la novela clásica, y tiene la intención de vivir su propia vida, en especial cuando su antiguo novio, Patrick, aparezca de nuevo en su vida.

programme.title: Cuando cae la nieve
programme.desc: 1950, Moscú. La comunista Katya (Rebecca Ferguson) es una espía del gobierno americano en plena carrera armamentística de la Guerra Fría. Cuando le asignan su misión más importante, conseguir información secreta de la joven promesa del gobierno ruso, Alexander (Sam Reid, Charles Dance), lo último que espera es que va a enamorarse de él. Intentar conciliar su pasión hacia a él con su rechazo al comunismo la llevará a hacer el mayor de los sacrificios, un gesto que Alexander descubrirá treinta años más tarde.

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Año de Gracia
programme.desc: Gràcia es una mujer de sesenta y pico años que vive sola y se siente muy abandonada. La pesada soledad le acerca hasta David, un joven estudiante de veinte años a quien ofrece una habitación en su casa a cambio de algo que no tiene y que le hace mucha falta.

programme.title: Mi gran despedida
programme.desc: Tres amores: el de Puri, dispuesta a hacer lo posible y lo imposible por dejar las cosas claras con su novio el de Milagro, que guarda más secretos de los que su naturaleza le permite, y el de Sara, cuya inminente boda reúne a un variopinto grupo de mujeres para festejar su compromiso.

programme.title: Tiempo después
programme.desc: Año 9177, en un futuro postapocalíptico. El mundo entero se ha visto reducido a un edificio y unas afueras. En el edificio vive el "establishment", las fuerzas vivas, y en las afueras miles y miles de parados.

programme.title: María (y los demás)
programme.desc: Desde que murió su madre, María ha cuidado de su padre y de sus hermanos. Responsable y controladora, siempre ha sido el pilar de la familia y se siente orgullosa de ello. Por eso, cuando su padre anuncia que se casa con Cachita, su simpática enfermera, María siente que su mundo se desmorona.

programme.title: Animales Heridos
programme.desc: Historias que se cruzan sobre parejas, la soledad y las heridas del amor.

programme.title: Legend of the Muse
programme.desc: A painter's life is changed forever when a mythical and deadly spirit from Celtic lore becomes his muse and lover.

programme.title: End of the World
programme.desc: After witnessing a man's death in a bizarre accident, Father Pergado goes on a spiritual retreat, where he encounters his alien double bent on world conquest.

programme.title: Cub
programme.desc: A camping trip turns into a carnage for a troop of cub scouts as a killer stalks them with deadly traps.

programme.title: Like A Bat Outta Hell
programme.desc: A young group of avid documentary film makers are sent to shoot in the vast extremes of the South Australian wilderness. They end up in a place called Nowhere Else. What transpires there is devastatingly, like nothing else on Earth.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: Problemas en el Paraiso
programme.desc: Rachel, una reciente viuda, viaja de regreso a Estados Unidos en un barco de carga con el cuerpo de su esposo cuando el barco naufraga en una isla desierta. Solo hay otro sobreviviente y ambos están decididos a ser rescatados. Tras una serie de eventos extremos, finalmente son encontrados, pero por su esposo, quien había fingido su muerte.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer 1
programme.desc: Un monje caucásico de Shanghai se infiltra en los bajos fondos para encontrar a los asesinos de su Gran Maestro espiritual femenino.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: The Unthinkable
programme.desc: Suecia se enfrenta a un misterioso ataque y Alex se ve forzado a volver a su hogar. Allí se enfrentará a su padre y se encontrará con su antiguo amor de juventud.

programme.title: Comando War Pigs
programme.desc: Al Capitán de la Segunda Guerra Mundial Jack Wosick, se le da la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se le designa para dirigir una unidad variopinta de soldados inadaptados conocidos como los “War Pigs”.

programme.title: Infalible
programme.desc: Kevin, Rob y Sam son miembros de un grupo que, sólo en teoría, planea asaltos perfectos, como hobby, sin la menor intención de llevarlos a cabo. Un gángster encuentra parte de su material de trabajo y decide chantajearlos para que realicen un robo millonario.

programme.title: Jackie Chan: Maestro en Kung Fu
programme.desc: Jackie Chan es el invicto Maestro de Kung Fu que reparte acción al estilo tradicional de Jackie Chan. Cuando un joven se dispone a aprender a luchar del mismísimo Maestro, no sólo es testigo de espectaculares combates, sino que aprende importantes lecciones de vida por el camino.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente II
programme.desc: Un especialista antiterrorista encargado de localizar a un terrorista.

programme.title: Transmorphers
programme.desc: Una raza de robots alienígenas ha conquistado la Tierra.

programme.title: Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Dos equipos de buscadores de tesoros realizan una excavación ilegal en la isla de Corregidor, Filipinas.

programme.title: Hurricane
programme.desc: Pilotos polacos luchan en la Batalla de Inglaterra.

programme.title: Invasión A La Tierra
programme.desc: Durante muchos años ha habido casos documentados sobre testigos que han visto OVNIS en todo el mundo.Pero lo que hasta ese momento eran simples avistamientos, en 2011 se convierte en una terrible realidad cuando la Tierra es atacada por fuerzas desconocidas.Una tras otra van cayendo las grandes ciudades del mundo, y Los Ángeles se ha convertido en el último bastión de la humanidad. Un sargento de la Marina (Aaron Eckhart) y sus hombres tendrán que enfrentarse en una inesperada batalla a un enemigo absolutamente desconocido.

programme.title: Anaconda 4: Rastro De Sangre
programme.desc: Una cría de anaconda, genéticamente mejorada, se ha regenerado y crece monstruosamente. La cría sedienta de sangre es aparentemente invencible, y se desliza entre explosiones y disparos para regenerarse y alimentarse insaciablemente de todo lo que se encuentre en su camino.

programme.title: Anaconda 3: La Amenaza
programme.desc: En un centro de investigación en un bosque europeo, un brillante científico está realizando esperimentos con dos colosales serpientes. Pero cuando el hombre de negocios que financia todo, lleva el experimento demasiado lejos, las serpientes escapan, hambrientas y dirigiéndose hacia la civilización.
